data.name: Galeela
data.gender_notes: Galeela is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'galala', meaning 'to be joyful or radiant'. This name is mentioned in various Islamic traditions as a name of a virtuous woman or an angel. The name Galeela carries the meaning “Joyful, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Galeela usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the joy and radiance of the presence of Allah in one's life.
data.etymology: Galeela belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Galeela total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

Additionally, some Islamic scholars believe that 'Galeela' is also the name of an angel who is responsible for dispersing joy and happiness among human beings. Hence, the name 'Galeela' is not only beautiful and auspicious, but it also embodies the Islamic values of kindness, generosity, and joyfulness.
